# Rohi International Travels

> Pakistan-based travel agency (est. 1991) offering live group fares to UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, and Umrah return fares. Bookings via WhatsApp at 0305 6622988.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Live group fares with route, airline, schedule, baggage, and price. Search by origin/destination and filter by city.
- [Fare Templates](/templates): Shareable fare poster templates with copy, download, and WhatsApp share.
- [Discount Vouchers](/discountvouchers): Live discount voucher inventory with PNR expiry and status.
- [Ticket Print Format](/print-format): Upload a ticket and download a branded PDF with the Rohi header/footer; fare & taxes auto-hidden.
- [Date Calculator](/calculator): Add/subtract days, age & duration, days between, and a discount calculator.
